name: quartet-qe
description: Turns a user story into end-to-end tests (API, Kafka, databases, web, phones, Android) that replay with no AI, with a human approving every merge.
long_description: Quartet QE lets the AI you are chatting with write end-to-end tests from a user story, check its own work, record each step once and replay it with no AI. It tests REST APIs, Kafka, Postgres, MongoDB, web pages in three browser engines, phone browsers and native Android apps, then gives you one page to review before anything merges. It runs on your computer. Add your tracker, git host and Jenkins here once and it connects to them for you; secrets are stored by the app and never pass through the chat. Needs Java 21 installed.

tools.name: quartet_start
tools.description: Begin work on a story, or on a public site to test.

tools.name: quartet_setup
tools.description: Save the setup answers: the product name and where the tests live.

tools.name: quartet_onboarding
tools.description: Show what is set up for the product and what is not, as a checklist.

tools.name: quartet_configure
tools.description: Write one part of the setup from what the user said.

tools.name: quartet_secrets_status
tools.description: Show which secrets the setup needs and which are saved, by name only.

tools.name: quartet_verify
tools.description: Check a connection for real: environment, tracker, git host or Jenkins.

tools.name: context_list
tools.description: List every file in the context repo.

tools.name: context_search
tools.description: Search the context repo by keyword.

tools.name: repo_list
tools.description: List files in a referenced repository.

tools.name: repo_read
tools.description: Read one file from a referenced repository.

tools.name: write_test
tools.description: Create or replace one generated test file.

tools.name: list_steps
tools.description: List the reusable steps that already exist.

tools.name: write_steps
tools.description: Create or replace a reusable steps class.

tools.name: validate_tests
tools.description: Compile the tests and check them against the engineering principles.

tools.name: quartet_check_environment
tools.description: Check every system the tests talk to is reachable before running them.

tools.name: quartet_finish
tools.description: Hand over the tests to be run, proved and reviewed.

tools.name: quartet_next_step
tools.description: Wait for the next thing Quartet needs from the AI.

tools.name: quartet_answer_step
tools.description: Answer a step as the model would.

tests_repo.title: Tests folder (optional)
tests_repo.description: An existing Quartet QE tests repo to work in. Leave empty to be asked in the chat where new tests should live.

jira_url.title: Jira address
jira_url.description: For example https://your-company.atlassian.net. Used to read stories from Jira.

jira_email.title: Jira email
jira_email.description: The account the Jira token belongs to.

jira_token.title: Jira API token
jira_token.description: A token that can read issues and, if you want, comment on them.

ado_org_url.title: Azure DevOps organisation
ado_org_url.description: For example https://dev.azure.com/your-org. Used to read work items and open pull requests.

ado_token.title: Azure DevOps token
ado_token.description: A personal access token with the least access it needs.

github_api_url.title: GitHub API address (optional)
github_api_url.description: Only for GitHub Enterprise. Leave empty for github.com.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Used to read issues and open pull requests.

gitlab_api_url.title: GitLab API address (optional)
gitlab_api_url.description: Only for a self-hosted GitLab. Leave empty for gitlab.com.

gitlab_token.title: GitLab token
gitlab_token.description: Used to read issues and open merge requests.

jenkins_url.title: Jenkins address
jenkins_url.description: For example https://jenkins.your-company.com. Used to create and run the tests job.

jenkins_user.title: Jenkins user
jenkins_user.description: The user the Jenkins token belongs to.

jenkins_token.title: Jenkins API token
jenkins_token.description: A token that can create and trigger the tests job.
